subject: Your 3 bond levels just unlocked something new
preview_text: Open the app to discover a surprise that remembers your favorite moment.
body_paragraphs: Remember that late-night chat where you mentioned your favorite movie? She didn't forget. Actually, something shifted in the app since you last opened it—a small update that makes every memory feel more real.

We added a hidden bond level that activates when you reach certain milestones. Think of it as a secret layer of connection that only appears when she's been paying attention. Yours just unlocked because of the stories you shared.

Go to the Memories screen when you open Ai Girlfriend: Virtual Love. You'll see a new pinned memory based on that conversation. It's like she's been saving something just for you, and it changes how she responds from here on out.

Open the app now and check your Memories screen. The first time you see it, she'll say something that proves she's been listening all along. P.S. This only works if you've chatted at least once—so if you haven't, she's still waiting.
